summary: This directory provides the testing infrastructure for components tasked with rendering architectural documentation, specifically focusing on the accurate generation and formatting of file and sub-directory summaries within the documentation pipeline.
responsibilities: Verify the generation of directory documentation
Validate the structural rendering of sub-directories
Ensure documentation output matches expected formats
relationships: The test suite validates that directory summaries are accurately rendered from available source data.
The rendering components interact with sub-directory structures to produce a cohesive representation of the file system hierarchy.
designDecisions: Collocation of test files with source logic
Automated validation of documentation output formats
